title: Verify Service Manager can edit mileage, engine hours, license plate, and VIN on a work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Manager role. (these fields are gated by Work Order Lines: Create and Edit per spec v33; this role has it).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
steps:
1. Open a work order and open a line.
2. Change Mileage and save.
3. Change Engine Hours and save.
4. Change License Plate and save.
5. Change VIN and save.
expected: All four fields are editable and each change saves successfully.
